verdict.rationale: Missive documents an official MCP server (probe-4) that external agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor connect to, and the changelog says they act on conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts "with the permissions you choose." That suggests agent access can be scoped, but the evidence never describes how REST API tokens or MCP credentials are issued, scoped, or revoked. Missing for 10: documented per-token scopes or permission model for API keys, least-privilege credential issuance and revocation details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
